parse_args_from_dataclass: parse command line arguments into a typed Python dataclass instance using parse_args
build_cli_parser_from_dataclass: build an argparse CLI parser from a Python dataclass using to_cli
convert_flat_dict_to_dataclass: convert a flat dot-separated dictionary into a nested dataclass using from_cli
create_nocli_field: create a dataclass field excluded from CLI arguments using the NOCLI helper
parse_boolean_flag: parse command line boolean strings like true false on off into Python booleans using bool_flag
